Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Record Class WarpGrid

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model.WarpGrid
public record WarpGrid(int rows, int columns, boolean quadTransform, List<Point2> controlPoints) extends Record
Complete immutable Warp Deformer grid for one Editor-authoring replacement operation.

rows() and columns() are positive cell counts. controlPoints() is defensively copied and must contain exactly (rows + 1) * (columns + 1) points, in the provider-defined grid order. This is a detached value, not a live Warp Deformer or mutable Editor grid.

  • Constructor Details

    • WarpGrid

      public WarpGrid(int rows, int columns, boolean quadTransform, List<Point2> controlPoints)
      Creates a validated immutable grid.
      Parameters:
      rows - the positive number of grid rows
      columns - the positive number of grid columns
      quadTransform - whether the grid uses quadrilateral transformation
      controlPoints - the control points in provider-defined grid order
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if controlPoints or one of its elements is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if dimensions are non-positive or the point count is wrong
